subject: GCP listing: seller intake -> contract handoff / procurement workflow

From: Acme Cloud Procurement <procure@acmecloud.com>

Cc: Lucie Tremblay <lucie.t@gcp-partner.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps for GCP listing / procurement items

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We're excited to move forward with a Marketplace listing for Acme Cloud's data-ops offering. Procurement has a handful of required artifacts before legal can sign off:

- Standard vendor contract (we need the seller agreement + any SOW template)
- Completed supplier security questionnaire (SOC2 baseline)
- Billing/PO contact and invoicing cadence

Can you confirm who on your side will own the contract redline and the questionnaire? Our procurement lead (cc'ed) would like a single point of contact to avoid back-and-forth across multiple teams. Also looping the GCP onboarding contact to coordinate the listing checklist.

Target timeline from our side: get paperwork in by 10/15 to hit an internal go-live target in early Nov. Please let us know if that's feasible.

Thanks,
Aaron Patel
Procurement Manager, Acme Cloud Inc.
[Attachment: Acme_Supplier_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]

Mateo / team — attached is my first-pass redline on the seller agreement. Major highlights:

- Limited liability language tightened (retain standard cap but clarified service exclusions)
- Data residency & logging: added a paragraph for customer-specific requirements and proposed references to our SOC2 report (we should attach)
- Payment terms: proposed Net45 for enterprise customers; recommend allowing PO-based invoices for Acme
- SLA / credits: maintained current Redwood template but added an optional SLA uplift clause for Dedicated customers (flagged for negotiation)

I'll also start populating the supplier questionnaire — I'll push the first draft by COB Monday (10/12).
